sampleSpecs.title: Three supplied API payloads
sampleSpecs.description: Two items, no items, and one item: the cases that expose unstable output shapes.

challenge.title: Keep only orders with at least one item
challenge.prompt: Return id and skus (a VARCHAR containing a JSON array) for orders with one or more items. Keep the array wrapper even for Cy’s single SKU.
challenge.hint: Use $count(items) to filter and [items.sku] to construct an array.
challenge.starter: SELECT id, jsonata('[items.sku]', payload)::VARCHAR AS skus FROM api_orders ORDER BY id;
challenge.solution: SELECT id, jsonata('[items.sku]', payload)::VARCHAR AS skus FROM api_orders WHERE jsonata('$count(items)', payload)::INTEGER > 0 ORDER BY id;
challenge.success: Ada and Cy remain. Cy still has an array with one element, so the receiving application does not need a special scalar case.
